title: International Business, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Penn State Erie, The Behrend College is the ONLY Penn State location offering this major -- there is no University Park equivalent to compare against, so this is a brand-new plan (Pattern A/B doesn't apply). New plan code IBBH invented (no existing UP 'International Business' major code to reuse) and confirmed non-colliding against every existing degree_plans/ major code. This is Behrend's own DUAL-DEGREE program: every IB student also completes a full second Black School of Business major (Accounting, Business Economics, Economics, Finance, Interdisciplinary Business with Engineering Studies, MIS, Marketing, or Project and Supply Chain Management) chosen by the student -- 'Supporting Course (Second Major)'/'Supporting Course (2nd Business Major)' slots (6 total, 18cr) represent this second major's required coursework, which this app cannot resolve to specific courses since it plans one major at a time; a real user should combine this plan with their own second major's plan (e.g. one of this batch's other Behrend plans, or a University Park plan if the second major is UP-based). This is disclosed rather than guessed, per this app's own 'never fabricate a course list' standard. Total credits: 128, matching the bulletin's own stated total exactly (every term's row-by-row sum, including the Third Year's 3-term Fall/Spring/Summer layout, matches its own printed subtotal exactly) -- PLUS one added MATH 21 (see below). Built entirely from Behrend's own 2026-27 Suggested Academic Plan PDF (international-business-bs_suggestedacademicplantext.pdf). Has a real, mandatory Education Abroad requirement (minimum 3cr, modeled as a Third Year Summer term) and a 'proficient in a second world language' requirement (modeled as 5 generic 'IL/US Cultures or World Language' slots, 15cr total, per the bulletin's own 'World culture/language courses: 15 credits' category). Real prereq fixes: (1) ACCTG 211/SCM 200/STAT 200 (Second Year Fall) real-require MATH 21 per the shared catalogs, never listed in Behrend's own suggested plan -- added MATH 21 explicitly in First Year Fall (current math_catalog.json's MATH 21 has an empty prereq_groups list, no further chain needed); bumped max_credits_per_semester to 18.5 to fit the addition into First Year Fall's own 15.5cr term without spilling into a later term ahead of other prereq-chain courses. (2) IB 404 (a REQUIRED prescribed course, Fourth Year Spring) real-requires BA 301 per ib_catalog.json -- but BA 301 ('Finance', a non-business-major survey course) is explicitly mutually exclusive with FIN 301 per its own catalog description ('credit toward graduation for only one of the following: BA 301, FIN 100, or FIN 301'), and every Behrend business major (including this one) requires FIN 301, not BA 301 -- meaning IB 404 would be permanently unschedulable for every real Behrend IB student as originally scraped. The very same catalog already treats BA 301's marketing/management siblings (BA 303, BA 304) as interchangeable with their major-specific equivalents elsewhere (MKTG 342/445/327 all accept 'BA 303 OR MKTG 301'; MGMT 461 accepts 'BA 304 OR MGMT 301') -- so patching IB 404's prereq to accept FIN 301 as an equivalent alternative to BA 301 (ib_catalog.json) follows the catalog's own established pattern, is real and sourced, and is purely additive (no existing University Park plan requires IB 404 directly, so nothing UP-side is affected). 'International Business Course' pool (x2: Third Year Spring, Fourth Year Fall) uses Behrend's own enumerated 'International Business Electives' list (ECON 470, FIN 471, IB 350) -- ACCTG 461 (also on that list) is excluded here since its own real prereq (ACCTG 471 AND ACCTG 472) needs ACCTG 471, a University Park-only course never offered at Behrend, making it permanently unschedulable in this catalog regardless of curriculum; disclosed rather than silently included as a dead option.
